QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Eastern Castle Situation
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Edea said you first need to steal the key from the guardian in the east to open the throne door. Go to #bB2 in the east of the castle#k, defeat the #renemy#k, and seize the moment.
QuestInfo.2: You reported on the strange creatures in the east of the castle. Edea said the past guardian of the east must still remain...

0.0: We're going to steal the key from the guardian of the east first. Please head towards the #bEast Laboratory#k of the #bTyrant's Castle#k. We don't know what enemies are there, as that area hasn't been scouted yet, but there will surely be unidentified creatures if the guardian still remains.
0.1: Go to #bLaboratory B2#k and defeat the #renemies#k to ascertain the situation. Defeat around #r100#k and then contact me over the communicator.\r\n\r\n#e#r* You will move to the quest map automatically upon accepting.#k

yes.0: Then I'll leave it to you.

no.0: I'll wait if you need to prepare.

1.0: Did you check the situation in the east of the castle? Did you see strange creatures with a #rflask on their head#k?

yes.0: I see. Those are #rcreatures made by the guardian of the east#k in the past. It seems the guardians must still be there.
yes.1: I understand the situation. It's dangerous, but fortunately, they are not complete unknowns. We have information that we can use to our advantage.

mob.0: Go to #bLaboratory B2#k and defeat the #renemies#k to ascertain the situation. Defeat around #r30#k and then contact me over the communicator.
